title: Data-Broker Opt-Out Tracker
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=breach:alert event=optout
| stats latest(status) as status, latest(_time) as updated by broker
| eval stale=if(status="listed" OR (now()-updated)>15552000,1,0)
| where stale=1
| sort broker
description: Tracks your data-broker opt-out requests and flags those that lapsed or where you have reappeared.
value: Data brokers re-list you over time; tracking opt-outs keeps your personal data off people-search sites.
implementation: Log opt-out requests and re-checks into `index=personal`; flag brokers to re-submit.
visualization: Table of data brokers needing an opt-out refresh.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks your requests to remove your details from data brokers and flags when you reappear on them.
